arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_code, concept_name, vocabulary_id, domain_id, concept_class_id
FROM omop.concept 
WHERE standard_concept = 'S' AND domain_id = 'Drug'
  AND (LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%methotrexate%'
       OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%mycophenolic acid%'
       OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%mycophenolate mofetil%'
       OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%azathioprine%'
       OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%cyclosporine%'
       OR LOWER(concept_code) LIKE 'methotrexate%')
